gt_provenance.details: HumanML motion, text, source path, and endpoint condition are dataset-derived rather than derived from the evaluated model output. The semantic score is explicitly a frozen learned proxy over simulated actual-state motion. The real provenance does not cure the world-anchor defect.

score_normalization.details: No reported metric divides by statistics of the current prediction. Candidate ranking uses fixed frozen thresholds, and raw values remain available.

result_existence.details: All required historical files exist and all recomputed counts/gates match exactly. All 74 registered result triplets hash correctly. There are 61 execution-bound and 13 retrospective certifications, all marked non-confirmatory. The HTML title is stale relative to the current publisher source, while its body discloses the diagnostic limitation.

dead_code.details: Core measurement checks, collection, analysis, and semantic evaluation are connected to the executed pipeline, and their outputs appear in saved metrics and summaries.

scope.details: The main run covers 10 arms, 48 internal test sources, three diffusion seeds, and 432 attempts per arm, but seed and offset effects are confounded by the world-anchor defect and the joint endpoint is near a complete floor.

eval_type.details: Dataset-derived HumanML reference/condition; model-produced motion candidates; Isaac Gym-only physical measurements; frozen learned semantic proxy. No human or real-robot evaluation.

source_group_split.limitation: The internal split does not establish independence from pretrained weights; 41 of 48 study-test sources originate from official HumanML train and 7 from official test.

immutable_targets.details: Paired methods within each case and seed share the same original goal and case order. Reference/actual anchors and realized nominal offsets are not comparable across seed runs.

actual_reference_timestamps.details: Reference frame indices are explicit and validated as 0..119; actions are applied before simulation and actual states are recorded after the step. The old dataset contains no pre-action actual sample and begins with the coordinate mismatch.

condition_update_bounds.details: Total translation <=0.15 m; step translation <=0.05 m; heading step <=5 degrees; total heading <=15 degrees.

candidate_budget_fairness.details: All primary arms use three candidates. One-candidate raw, ordinary, and native_single arms are excluded from the equal-budget numeric gate.

slip_proxy_geometry.details: Collision primitives and v+omega-cross-r point velocity are used, support requires body force z>10 N and surface height<2 cm, and penetration uses primitive surface geometry. Net body force cannot localize contact to the selected primitive surface point, and the fixed threshold creates an empirical floor.

gate_logic.details: The analyzer checks all six equal-budget arms, fixed thresholds, semantic hashes, and downstream stage status. The coordinate-invalid and degenerate inputs prevent scientific interpretation.

findings.title: Reference/goal and actual episode use different world anchors
findings.claim_impact: All efficacy, inefficacy, mechanism, seed, offset, and robustness inference from the historical run is unsupported.

findings.title: Joint gate is dominated by a slip-proxy floor
findings.details: Penetration passes every main attempt, slip passes only 1-5 of 432 per arm, physical passes only 1-2 of 432 per arm, and validation had zero joint passes before threshold freeze.
findings.claim_impact: Zero gains and [0,0] intervals do not show equivalence or absence of mechanism effect.

findings.title: Published HTML title is stale relative to current publisher source
findings.details: The saved HTML title contains controlled-diagnostic wording. Its body clearly disclaims controlled inference, and publication_versions correctly records the older producer hash.

findings.title: Thirteen result batches use retrospective compatibility certification
findings.details: There are 61 execution-bound and 13 retrospective exact-array/metric certifications. All are explicitly non-confirmatory; no original execution-time request hash is falsely claimed.

claims.claim: The historical package faithfully reports what was run.
The proposed method improves the joint endpoint.
Results are robust across seeds or nominal offsets.
Semantic quality and diversity were evaluated.
G1 or downstream training was completed.

action_items: Keep the historical run diagnostic and do not reuse its numbers for efficacy, inefficacy, robustness, seed, offset, or mechanism claims.
Run any coordinate repair as a new result family with reference, frozen target, and actual reset state aligned before the first action and with a saved pre-action state.
Calibrate and freeze a physically meaningful slip/contact threshold on a separate validation distribution, then retain component metrics alongside the joint endpoint.
Preserve execution-time requests and retrospective amendments; keep retrospective records non-confirmatory.
Regenerate the stale HTML title from the current publisher while retaining the old artifact and producer hash.
limitations: Same-family Codex review is provisional; no cross-family reviewer acceptance is claimed.
This audit evaluates the historical physics_guided_20261011 result family only.
Simulation-only contact and slip proxies are not physical robot validation.
A later successful reset-aligned experiment would require its own audit and cannot change this verdict retroactively.
